title: Preventing Data Hallucinations in Agentic AI for Optical Network Troubleshooting
title_zh: 【防智能体AI在光网络故障排查中的数据幻觉】

paragraphs.en: Service providers have a strong interest in automating root cause analysis (RCA) in Passive Optical Networks (PON) to minimize the impact of service degradations and outages. Root cause models for PONs analyze telemetry acquired from the equipment, such as Optical Line Terminals (OLTs) and Optical Network Units (ONUs), and predict probable causes, such as fiber bends, loose or dirty fibers, laser aging, power outages, or rogue ONUs. For use in real deployments, these models must be accurate and explainable to ensure reliability and operational trust. Only if the claimed root cause is sufficiently justified by the data, operators can trust the inference and confidently resolve the issue with appropriate remedies.
paragraphs.zh: 服务提供商非常希望在无源光网络（PON）中自动化根本原因分析（RCA），以最大限度地减少业务降级和中断的影响。 PON 的根本原因模型分析从设备（如光线路终端（OLT）和光网络单元（ONU））采集的遥测数据，并预测可能的原因，例如光纤弯曲、光纤松动或脏污、激光器老化、断电或流氓 ONU。 要在实际部署中使用，这些模型必须准确且可解释，以确保可靠性和运营信任。 只有当所声称的根本原因得到数据的充分论证时，运营人员才能信任推理结果，并有信心地采取适当的补救措施来解决问题。

paragraphs.en: Through recent advances in large language models (LLMs) [ 1 ] , AI agents [ 2 ] have become capable of advanced language understanding and sophisticated reasoning. Therefore, AI agents are a promising paradigm for automating the troubleshooting and root cause inference in optical networks to an unprecedented degree. In a typical setup, the agent is given access to the PON telemetry, a knowledge base, and a set of tools, and is instructed via a prompt to analyze the PON telemetry and infer the most likely root cause. However, while today’s LLM-based agents are useful tools for assisting human experts in ad-hoc root cause analysis, their black-box nature [ 3 , 4 ] and hallucinations [ 5 , 6 ] prevent the adoption for wide deployments in commercial networks, where operators expect explainable inference and interpretable root cause claims.
paragraphs.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）[1]的最新进展，AI智能体[2]已经具备了先进的语言理解能力和复杂的推理能力。 因此，AI智能体是在光网络中以前所未有的程度实现故障排查与根因推断自动化的一个有前景的范式。 在典型的设置中，智能体可以访问PON遥测数据、一个知识库和一组工具，并通过提示词被指示分析PON遥测数据并推断最可能的根因。 然而，尽管当今基于LLM的智能体是辅助人类专家进行临时根因分析的有用工具，但其黑盒特性[3,4]和幻觉问题[5,6]阻碍了它们在商业网络中广泛部署的采用，因为运营商期望可解释的推断和可解读的根因结论。

paragraphs.en: One of the major challenges with today’s AI agents is the risk of data hallucinations . Agents regularly generate responses that appear plausible but contain incorrect information [ 6 ] . By default, agent responses consist of raw text, in which the agent outlines its root cause claims and (if prompted to do so) the reasoning chain that substantiates this claim. However, these textual responses lack sufficient rigor that would allow operators to trust these responses. Whenever the agent makes a statement about the underlying PON telemetry, there is a risk that the agent hallucinates data, i.e., it refers to data in its responses that is not present in the actual PON telemetry. This makes standard AI agents unreliable and untrustworthy for troubleshooting commercial PONs.
paragraphs.zh: 当今AI智能体的主要挑战之一是数据幻觉的风险。 智能体经常生成看似合理但包含错误信息的回复 [ 6 ] 。 默认情况下，智能体的回复由原始文本组成，其中智能体阐述其根因结论，以及（在被要求时）支持该结论的推理链。 然而，这些文本回复缺乏足够的严谨性，无法让运维人员信任这些回复。 每当智能体对底层PON遥测数据作出陈述时，就存在智能体产生数据幻觉的风险，即它在回复中引用了实际PON遥测数据中并不存在的数据。 这使得标准AI智能体在商用PON故障排查方面不可靠且不值得信赖。

paragraphs.en: In this demonstration, we present a new evidence-based framework for agentic network troubleshooting, in which the agent uses data references to point to data fragments in the PON telemetry. Using data references, the agent can cite specific subsets of the data in its claims and reasoning justifications, for example a spike or drop in a particular metric in a particular time window. We show how data references can be integrated into the agentic AI architecture and demonstrate their benefits in various degradation and fault scenarios on commercial PON equipment.
paragraphs.zh: 在本演示中，我们提出了一种新的基于证据的智能体网络故障排查框架，其中智能体使用数据引用来指向 PON 遥测中的数据片段。 借助数据引用，智能体可以在其论断和推理依据中引用数据的特定子集，例如特定时间窗口内某个指标的峰值或骤降。 我们展示了如何将数据引用集成到智能体 AI 架构中，并在商用 PON 设备上的多种劣化和故障场景中验证了其优势。

paragraphs.en: Currently, there is great interest in agentic AI methods for the monitoring, configuration and fault management of (optical) communication networks [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] driven by fast progress in LLMs and agentic AI research. Our demonstration is aligned with these developments and enhances the current agentic AI architecture. The problem of hallucinations and low reliability of agentic AI (and generative AI more broadly) is a major challenge [ 9 ] that must be addressed.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，受大语言模型（LLM）和智能体AI研究快速进展的推动，智能体AI方法在（光）通信网络的监控、配置与故障管理方面引起了极大兴趣 [7, 8, 9, 10]。 我们的演示与这些发展趋势相一致，并增强了当前的智能体AI架构。 智能体AI（以及更广泛意义上的生成式AI）的幻觉和低可靠性问题是一项必须解决的重大挑战 [9]。

paragraphs.en: The major novelty of the presented approach is the introduction of data references into the standard agentic AI architecture to enable evidence-based root cause analysis in optical networks. Agentic consumer applications, like ChatGPT, use citations to link to information found on a web site. Data references in our architecture serve a similar purpose, but they link to data sources and are tailored to the requirements in optical network troubleshooting. Specifically, data references are designed to work with common telemetry data formats, such as time series data, log files, and structured JSON. A data reference is a fine-grained pointer that not only identifies the data source but also a specific data fragment, such as a line range in a log file, a snippet in a JSON object, or a window of a time series metric. In our implementation, data references are stored as URIs where parameters are used to encode information about the OLT, ONU, metric, time window, etc.
paragraphs.zh: 本文方法的主要创新点在于将数据引用引入标准智能体（agentic）AI架构，以支持光网络中基于证据的根因分析。 ChatGPT 等智能体消费者应用使用引文链接到网站上找到的信息。 我们架构中的数据引用起到类似的作用，但它们链接到数据源，并针对光网络故障排查的需求进行了定制。 具体而言，数据引用被设计为可与常见的遥测数据格式协同工作，例如时间序列数据、日志文件和结构化 JSON。 数据引用是一种细粒度的指针，它不仅标识数据源，还标识特定的数据片段，例如日志文件中的行范围、JSON 对象中的片段，或时间序列指标中的一个时间窗口。 在我们的实现中，数据引用以 URI 的形式存储，其中使用参数编码关于 OLT、ONU、指标、时间窗口等信息。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 1 shows the Agentic AI for Optical Network Troubleshooting and its interaction with external systems and actors. The networks under observation are PONs that are monitored by a data collector. Via the OLT, the data collector acquires telemetry that provides insights into the state and performance of the optical network, including traffic counters, bit-interleaved-parity (BIP) error counters, TX/RX power levels, as well as detailed alarm logs. The networks can suffer impairments caused by fiber bends, loose connectors, sudden power outages, etc., whose diagnosis is time-consuming and costly in large installations. Whenever the service quality degrades, the operator can start a chat-based interaction with the agent to trigger the data collection and diagnosis process. The data collector takes a snapshot of the recent OLT telemetry and uploads it to the data lake in the cloud. This case data serves as the input data for the agent’s diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 图1展示了用于光网络故障排查的智能体式AI（Agentic AI）及其与外部系统和参与者的交互。 受观测的网络是由数据采集器监控的无源光网络（PON）。 数据采集器通过OLT获取遥测数据，从而洞察光网络的状态与性能，包括流量计数器、比特交织奇偶校验（BIP）错误计数器、TX/RX功率电平以及详细的告警日志。 这些网络可能因光纤弯曲、连接器松动、突发断电等原因而受到损伤，在大型部署环境中对此类问题的诊断既耗时又昂贵。 每当服务质量下降时，操作员可以与智能体启动基于对话的交互，以触发数据采集和诊断流程。 数据采集器对最近的OLT遥测数据拍摄快照，并将其上传到云端的数据湖。 该案例数据作为智能体进行诊断的输入数据。

sents.zh: 图1展示了用于光网络故障排查的智能体式AI（Agentic AI）及其与外部系统和参与者的交互。

paragraphs.en: In a first analysis step, anomaly detectors process the case data and identify anomalous data that deviates from expected data patterns. These anomaly detectors can be implemented with heuristic rules or machine learning models. Their purpose is to inject domain knowledge into the RCA process and to steer the agent’s attention towards interesting data sections. While this component is optional, it can help reduce the agent’s token consumption and costs. The anomaly detectors use data references to point to the data fragments where the anomaly was found. The data references are written to a file system, where they can be inspected by the agent with standard tools like ls, grep, and read_file.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一个分析步骤中，异常检测器处理案例数据，并识别出偏离预期数据模式的异常数据。 这些异常检测器可以用启发式规则或机器学习模型来实现。 它们的目的是将领域知识注入根因分析（RCA）流程，并引导智能体的注意力关注值得关注的数据部分。 虽然该组件是可选的，但它有助于降低智能体的 token 消耗和成本。 异常检测器使用数据引用来指向发现异常的数据片段。 数据引用被写入文件系统，智能体可以使用 ls、grep 和 read_file 等标准工具对其进行查看。

sents.zh: 在第一个分析步骤中，异常检测器处理案例数据，并识别出偏离预期数据模式的异常数据。

paragraphs.en: The agent uses an LLM by an external provider for analysis and reasoning. Guided by the system prompt, the agent inspects the data references in the file system. Additionally, the agent is equipped with data inspection tools that allow the agent to run data queries. For example, the agent may use a tool to identify the temporal overlap of two anomalies, or to compute the correlation between two performance metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体使用外部提供商的大语言模型进行分析和推理。 在系统提示词的引导下，智能体检查文件系统中的数据引用。 此外，该智能体还配备了数据检查工具，使其能够运行数据查询。 例如，智能体可以使用工具来识别两个异常的时间重叠，或计算两个性能指标之间的相关性。

sents.en: The agent uses an LLM by an external provider for analysis and reasoning.
sents.zh: 该智能体使用外部提供商的大语言模型进行分析和推理。

sents.zh: 在系统提示词的引导下，智能体检查文件系统中的数据引用。

sents.en: Additionally, the agent is equipped with data inspection tools that allow the agent to run data queries.
sents.zh: 此外，该智能体还配备了数据检查工具，使其能够运行数据查询。

sents.en: For example, the agent may use a tool to identify the temporal overlap of two anomalies, or to compute the correlation between two performance metrics.
sents.zh: 例如，智能体可以使用工具来识别两个异常的时间重叠，或计算两个性能指标之间的相关性。

paragraphs.en: One important technical innovation in this architecture is the enrichment of the agent–tool API contract: All data inspection tools include data references in their responses. This way, as the agent gathers information about the case data, it keeps track of the data locations.
paragraphs.zh: 该架构中一个重要的技术创新是丰富了智能体与工具之间的 API 契约：所有数据检查工具都会在响应中包含数据引用。 这样，智能体在收集有关案例数据的信息时，就能持续跟踪数据的位置。

sents.zh: 该架构中一个重要的技术创新是丰富了智能体与工具之间的 API 契约：所有数据检查工具都会在响应中包含数据引用。

paragraphs.en: When the agent generates its answer, it is not allowed to generate a copy of the data in its response, as this poses a risk of data hallucination. Instead, the agent is instructed via the prompt to use data references to substantiate its claims.
paragraphs.zh: 当智能体生成其回答时，不允许在响应中生成数据的副本，因为这会带来数据幻觉的风险。 相反，智能体通过提示词被指示使用数据引用来佐证其主张。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 2 shows an example: The time series of BIP errors of each ONU is stored in a data frame. If the agent wants to refer to an observed spike in the BIP error metric of ONU onu-345 at OLT olt-012 , it must include the correct data reference into its response. In this URI, the values parameter indicates the column of interest, the after and before parameters define the time window, groupby defines the grouping columns and groups defines a filter on these columns. Similar URI schemas exist in our demo implementation to refer to line ranges of log files and snippets of JSON objects.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Fig. 1 , the agent’s original response is sent to the evidence lookup module, which replaces the data references with the actual data fragments from the case data. We have developed an evidence query API that accepts data references and extracts the correct data fragments from the original case data. This enforcement mechanism guaranties that all the data that are displayed in the enriched response exist in the case data. If the agent hallucinated data references (which we have not observed in our experiments), the evidence lookup would fail, and a warning would be displayed to the user. Finally, the enriched response is sent to the user interface where it is displayed to the user.
paragraphs.zh: 如图1所示，智能体的原始响应被发送至证据查询模块，该模块将数据引用替换为来自案件数据的实际数据片段。 我们开发了一个证据查询API，该API接受数据引用，并从原始案件数据中提取正确的数据片段。 这一强制执行机制保证了丰富化响应中显示的所有数据都存在于案件数据中。 如果智能体产生了数据引用的幻觉（在实验中我们未观察到这种情况），证据查询将会失败，并向用户显示警告。 最后，丰富化响应被发送至用户界面，并在那里显示给用户。

paragraphs.en: Our demonstration contributes to the ECOC Demo Zone topic of AI/ML for network intelligence . The application of LLMs and agentic AI to optical networks is an emerging and rapidly evolving research area of significant relevance to the ECOC community. At the same time, data hallucinations remain a major obstacle to the adoption of AI agents in operational networks, where incorrect decisions can have substantial operational and economic impact. Consequently, improving the robustness, reliability, interpretability, and trustworthiness of AI agents is a critical requirement for delegating operational decisions to such systems. In this context, our demonstration presents a novel integration of LLM-based agent systems and data references for optical network monitoring and troubleshooting. The demo illustrates how combining the adaptability of modern AI agents with the explainability provided by data references can enable more trustworthy and resilient network operations. As such, the work is relevant to both researchers and network operators attending ECOC.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的演示为 ECOC 演示区「面向网络智能的人工智能/机器学习」主题做出贡献。 将大语言模型和智能体人工智能应用于光网络，是一个新兴且快速发展的研究领域，与 ECOC 社区高度相关。 与此同时，数据幻觉仍然是人工智能智能体在实际运营网络中应用的主要障碍，因为错误的决策可能带来重大的运营和经济影响。 因此，提升人工智能智能体的鲁棒性、可靠性、可解释性和可信度，是将运营决策委托给此类系统的关键要求。 在此背景下，我们的演示展示了一种将基于大语言模型的智能体系统与数据引用相结合、用于光网络监控和故障排除的新型集成方案。 该演示展示了如何将现代人工智能智能体的适应性与数据引用所提供的可解释性相结合，从而实现更可信、更具韧性的网络运营。 因此，这项工作与出席 ECOC 的研究人员和网络运营者都具有相关性。

paragraphs.en: The objective of the demo is to demonstrate how an agentic AI system for troubleshooting optical network issues can be made reliable and trustworthy. In particular, the demo illustrates how the proposed data-reference approach prevents data hallucinations, thereby improving the interpretability and trustworthiness of the root-cause claims generated by the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 本演示的目标是展示如何使一个用于光网络故障排查的智能体式 AI 系统具备可靠性和可信度。 具体而言，该演示展示了所提出的数据引用方法如何防止数据幻觉，从而提升智能体生成的根因结论的可解释性和可信度。

paragraphs.en: The agentic AI system is implemented as a Python application using the deepagents 1 1 1 https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents (Accessed: 2026-05-22) library by LangChain to realize the agent harness. The agent operates in a reasoning loop in which it is guided by a prompt and invokes tools as needed. Specialized tools were implemented that allow the agent to inspect the case data. Both anomaly detectors and data inspection tools include data references in their responses. Rendering functions were implemented to visualize these references with plots and quotes from the underlying telemetry data. Most commercially available LLMs can be used within the system through LangChain’s integrations with common model providers.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体式AI系统实现为一个Python应用，使用LangChain的deepagents 1 1 1 https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents (Accessed: 2026-05-22) 库来实现智能体运行框架。 该智能体在一个推理循环中运行，在此循环中它由提示词引导，并按需调用工具。 我们实现了专门的工具，使智能体能够检查案件数据。 异常检测器和数据检查工具都会在响应中包含数据引用。 我们实现了渲染函数，以便通过图表和底层遥测数据的引文来可视化这些引用。 大多数市售大语言模型都可以通过LangChain与常见模型提供商的集成在该系统中使用。

paragraphs.en: The demo involves multiple lab installations at Adtran premises, consisting of OLTs and multiple ONUs. Similar to the techniques used by [ 11 , 12 ] , representative faults will be provoked on these installations, including distribution fiber cuts, feeder fiber cuts, and sudden ONU power outages. Through the data collector, the agentic system acquires live telemetry data from these installations. This setup enables the demonstration of different failure modes and provides diverse troubleshooting scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 该演示涉及Adtran场地的多个实验室安装设备，包括OLT和多台ONU。 类似于[11,12]所用技术，将在这些安装设备上触发代表性故障，包括配线光纤断裂、馈线光纤断裂和ONU突然断电。 通过数据采集器，智能体系统从这些安装设备获取实时遥测数据。 该设置能够展示不同的故障模式，并提供多样化的故障排查场景。

sents.en: This setup enables the demonstration of different failure modes and provides diverse troubleshooting scenarios.
sents.zh: 该设置能够展示不同的故障模式，并提供多样化的故障排查场景。

paragraphs.en: Attendees will interact with the system through the web-based user interface. They will be able to engage with the agent in multi-turn conversations. The agent performs root-cause analysis (RCA) on live telemetry data and uses data references to point to relevant fragments of the underlying data. The user interface visualizes the referenced PON telemetry through plots and quotes. By contrasting this evidence-based implementation with an agentic analysis approach that does not use data references, the advantages of the proposed method for interpretability and trustworthiness are highlighted.
paragraphs.zh: 与会者将通过基于网页的用户界面与系统进行交互。 他们将能够与该智能体进行多轮对话。 该智能体对实时遥测数据执行根因分析（RCA），并使用数据引用来指向底层数据的相关片段。 用户界面通过图表和引用内容将所引用的PON遥测数据进行可视化展示。 通过将这种基于证据的实现与不使用数据引用的智能体分析方法进行对比，凸显了所提方法在可解释性和可信度方面的优势。
